messages.author: Justinian
messages.text:
Fixed the distribution in a few of my provinces and they are still losing people.
Before one of the updates I cleared 10m an hour, pretty sure I have over double the mills and yet my income drops

messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text: What is your housing % at? Only thing I can think of is you are close to 100% housing so pop growth is less then death

messages.author: Justinian
messages.text:
Homes / hospitals

10% full (2.49B homes, 6 hospitals, 2% covered)

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@307290318590705667> found it. it's food distribution, not housing or hospitals. you have plenty of rations stocked, but your distribution centers and malls can only hand food out to about 154m people and your nation has about 254m, so roughly 39% of your people aren't getting fed each hour. that makes them starve (around 0.4% of the population an hour) and stops births in those areas, so provinces shrink even with full distribution set. fewer working people also means your mills run below capacity, which is why income dropped even though you built more. to cover everyone you need about 170 distribution centers (you have 73) or an equivalent number of malls, which serve 5m each. once coverage hits 100% the shrinking stops and growth comes back. sorry it's not shown clearly in the UI, we'll look at making it clearer

messages.author: Justinian
messages.text: Why aren't the provinces that were fully supplied growing then?

title: Provinces Losing Pop Despite full distribution/Resource income dropping despite building more mines
